batterycraft.options.enabled.tooltip: Apply battery-aware profiles. Disabling restores your original settings.
batterycraft.options.mode.tooltip: Automatic follows your battery and charger. Manual modes force the selected profile.
batterycraft.options.sodium.tooltip: Allow profiles to reduce entity distance when Sodium is installed.
batterycraft.options.thermal.tooltip: Experimental macOS thermal warnings can select a stronger saving profile.
batterycraft.options.low_threshold.toolt: Battery percentage at which low-battery mode starts.
Critical mode starts immediately at this percentage. Kept below the low-battery threshold.
batterycraft.options.poll.tooltip: How often macOS battery information is read. This does not control messages.
batterycraft.options.transition.tooltip: Wait before changing profiles. Critical battery bypasses this delay.
batterycraft.options.notifications.toolt: Show a chat notification when the active profile changes.
batterycraft.options.status.tooltip: Show battery percentage and remaining time above the hotbar. Off by default.
batterycraft.options.minutes.tooltip: The full interval is minutes + extra seconds. Example: 15 minutes + 0 seconds, or 30 minutes + 0 seconds. Enable the periodic message and click Apply. Minimum total: 5 seconds.
batterycraft.options.seconds.tooltip: Extra seconds are added to the minutes. For exactly 15 minutes, choose 15 minutes + 0 seconds. After Apply, the first message waits the full interval.
batterycraft.options.fps.tooltip: Maximum FPS while this profile is active. 0 keeps Minecraft’s original FPS cap; it does not necessarily mean unlimited FPS. Reconnecting in Automatic mode restores your original settings. Higher FPS can use more battery.
batterycraft.options.render.tooltip: Maximum render distance for this profile. Lower original values are preserved.
batterycraft.options.simulation.tooltip: Maximum simulation distance for this profile. Lower values reduce world simulation workload.
batterycraft.options.particles.tooltip: 0: all; 1: decreased; 2: minimal. Original lighter settings are preserved.
batterycraft.options.clouds.tooltip: Allow clouds in this profile, respecting an original disabled setting.
batterycraft.options.shadows.tooltip: Allow entity shadows, respecting an original disabled setting.
batterycraft.options.biome.tooltip: Maximum biome blend radius. Lower values reduce blending work.
batterycraft.options.entities.tooltip: Entity distance as a percentage. Requires entity-distance integration to be enabled.
